payload.incompatible_about: Whom the verse addresses, according to two commentaries that bear the same author's name. Commenting on the Rigvedic occurrence Sayana supplies the vocative he vena; commenting on the Taittiriya-Brahmana occurrence of the same verse he supplies he pravargyasvāmin. Lanman calls it "an interesting diversity of opinion". The two identifications of the addressee are incompatible, and they are incompatible inside one commentarial tradition rather than between a commentator and a philologist -- which is why this row carries its own axis.
